method: Existing complete transfer verifier, five alternating pairs per mode, exact supported output/workspace/object/control/package state; source immutable and disposable file remote restored after each command.

host_monitor.method: aggregate /proc/stat busy excluding idle and iowait; sampled every 0.5 seconds outside command timing

performance_limitation: A concurrent pnpm test burst exceeded the predeclared 80% aggregate host CPU threshold. Parity passed; do not use these timings as speedup evidence.
